# Dive deep into SFPs

## Rare SFPs
These appear to be exclusively Early Archaic citations, so we could take them off:
```{r}
combo_list[which(sapply(combo_list, \(x) "思" %in% x$sfp))]
combo_list[which(sapply(combo_list, \(x) "居" %in% x$sfp))]
combo_list[which(sapply(combo_list, \(x) "止" %in% x$sfp))]
```

Let's remove them:
```{r}
remove_from_combo_list <- function(combo_list, to_rm, element){
    for(i in 1:length(combo_list)){
        combo_list[[i]][[element]] <-
            setdiff(combo_list[[i]][[element]], to_rm)
    }
    combo_list
}
combo_list <- remove_from_combo_list(combo_list, c("思", "居", "止"), "sfp")
sfp_vocab <- setdiff(sfp_vocab, c("思", "居", "止"))
```

Let's look at standalone 而:

```{r}
combo_list[which(
    sapply(combo_list,
    \(x) all(x$sfp == "而") & length(x$sfp) > 0))
        ]
```

Seems really uncommon, and never occurring with a dc anyways. So let's consolidate 而已:

```{r}
locate_subseq <- function(seq, subseq){
    looking = 0
    subseq_locs = list()
    start_idx_cand = numeric(0)

    for(i in 1:length(seq)){
        item = seq[i]
        if(looking == 0){
            # If we weren't previously in a candidate subseq
            if(item == subseq[1]){
                looking = 1
                start_idx_cand = i
            }
        } else if(looking > 0){
            # If we're in a candidate subseq
            if(item != subseq[looking + 1]){
                # Wrong thing? stop looking
                looking = 0
            } else if(looking + 1 == length(subseq)){
                looking = 0
                subseq_locs = c(subseq_locs, list(c(start_idx_cand, i)))
                start_idx_cand = numeric(0)
            }
        }
    }
    subseq_locs
}

merge_in_combo_list <- function(combo_list, to_merge, element){
    merged <- paste0(to_merge, collapse = "")
    # browser()
    for(i in 1:length(combo_list)){
        if(length(combo_list[[i]][[element]]) < length(to_merge)) next
        to_merge_locs <- locate_subseq(
            combo_list[[i]][[element]], to_merge
            )
        
        #the [1] is bc I don't actually support multiple yet
        if(length(to_merge_locs) > 1){
            for(loc in to_merge_locs[1]){
                if(i == 1312) browser()
                combo_list[[i]][[element]] <-
                    combo_list[[i]][[element]][-(loc[1]:loc[2])] |>
                    append(merged, after = loc[1] - 1)
            }
        }
    }
    combo_list
}
# test
merge_in_combo_list(
    list(list(sfp = c("焉", "而", "已", "矣"))),
    c("而", "已"),
    "sfp") |>
        print()

combo_list <- combo_list |>
    merge_in_combo_list(c("而", "已"), "sfp")
sfp_vocab <- c(sfp_vocab, "而已")
```

Rerunning vocab to check everything ran normally:
```{r}
sfp_vocab = map(
    combo_list, \(x) x$sfp
    ) |>
    reduce(c) |>
    unique()
print(sfp_vocab)
```

## Determining where to put an SFP

Find how many times SFPs are first and last in combos:
```{r}
vec_with_names <- function(names, type = "integer"){
    result <- vector(mode = "integer" , length = length(names))
    names(result) <- names
    result
}

list_with_names <- function(names){
    result <- vector(mode = "list" , length = length(names))
    names(result) <- names
    result
}
sfp_first_counts <- vec_with_names(sfp_vocab, type = "integer")
sfp_last_counts <- vec_with_names(sfp_vocab, type = "integer")

for(item in combo_list){
    if(length(item$sfp) > 1){
        print(item$sfp)
        sfp_first_counts[[item$sfp[1]]] <-
            sfp_first_counts[[item$sfp[1]]] + 1
        sfp_last_counts[[item$sfp[length(item$sfp)]]] <-
            sfp_last_counts[[item$sfp[length(item$sfp)]]] + 1
    }
}
```

```{r}
sfp_alone_loc <- vec_with_names(sfp_vocab, type = "integer")

for(sfp in sfp_vocab){
    if(sfp_first_counts[sfp] >= sfp_last_counts[sfp]){
        sfp_alone_loc[sfp] <- "f"
    } else sfp_alone_loc[sfp] <- "l"
}
print(sfp_alone_loc)
```

# Deep dive into DCs

# Deep dive into pairings

```{r}
dc_to_sfp <- vector(mode = "list" , length = length(dc_vocab))
names(dc_to_sfp) <- dc_vocab
sfp_to_dc <- vector(mode = "list" , length = length(sfp_vocab))
names(sfp_to_dc) <- sfp_vocab

for(combo_info in combo_list){
    for(dc in combo_info$dc){
        dc_to_sfp[[dc]] = unique(c(dc_to_sfp[[dc]], combo_info$sfp))
    }
    for(sfp in combo_info$sfp){
        sfp_to_dc[[sfp]] = unique(c(sfp_to_dc[[sfp]], combo_info$dc))
    }
}
```


```{r}
dc_removed <- character(0)
for(dc in names(dc_to_sfp)){
    if(length(dc_to_sfp[[dc]]) == 0){
        dc_removed <- c(dc_removed, dc)
        dc_to_sfp[[dc]] <- NULL
        dc_vocab <- setdiff(dc_vocab, dc)
    }
}
combo_list <- remove_from_combo_list(combo_list, dc_removed, "dc")


cli::cli_inform(glue::glue("Removing from dc: {paste0(dc_removed, collapse = ',')}"))
```


```{r}
sfp_removed <- character(0)
for(sfp in names(sfp_to_dc)){
    if(length(sfp_to_dc[[sfp]]) == 0){
        sfp_removed <- c(sfp_removed, sfp)
        sfp_to_dc[[sfp]] <- NULL
        sfp_vocab <- setdiff(sfp_vocab, sfp)
    }
}
combo_list <- remove_from_combo_list(combo_list, sfp_removed, "sfp")

cli::cli_inform(glue::glue("Removing from sfp: {paste0(sfp_removed, collapse = ',')}"))
```

# Dataframe creation


```{r}
get_bigrams = function(v){
    if(length(v) > 1){
        purrr::map(1:(length(v) - 1),
        \(i) v[i:(i + 1)]
        )
    } else if(v == "NONE"){
        list(c("NONE", "NONE"))
    } else { # length is 1
        if(sfp_alone_loc[[v]] == "f"){
            list(c("NONE", v))
        } else {
            list(c(v, "NONE"))
        }
    }
}

getRowsFromCombos = function(combos){
  n_sfp = length(combos$sfp)
  n_dc = length(combos$dc)
  if(n_sfp == 0) combos$sfp = "NONE"
  if(n_dc == 0) combos$dc = "NONE"
  combos$sfp = get_bigrams(combos$sfp)
    tidyr::expand_grid(sfp = combos$sfp, dc = combos$dc) |>
    mutate(sfp_1 = purrr::map(sfp, \(x) x[[1]]),
        sfp_2 = purrr::map(sfp, \(x) x[[2]])
        ) |>
    mutate(across(starts_with("sfp_"), unlist)) |>
    select(-sfp) |>
    mutate(docID = combos$docID,
            paragraphID = combos$paragraphID,
            sentenceID = combos$sentenceID,
            sentence = combos$sentence,
            .before = dc)
}

combosDF <- purrr::map(
    combo_list[combo_list_nonnull_locs],
    getRowsFromCombos,
    .progress = TRUE) |>
    bind_rows()

```


```{r}
combosDF <- combosDF |>
    mutate(
        dc = factor(dc, levels = c("NONE", dc_vocab)),
        sfp_1 = factor(
            sfp_1,
            levels = c("NONE", setdiff(unique(sfp_1), "NONE"))
        ),
        sfp_2 = factor(
            sfp_2,
            levels = c("NONE", setdiff(unique(sfp_2), "NONE"))
            ),
        docID = factor(
            docID,
            levels = sort(unique(docID))
        )
    )
```

```{r}
combosDF <- combosDF |>
    arrange(docID, sentenceID)
```

```{r}
unique_docs <- unique(combosDF$docID)
```

```{r}
combosDF_old <- read_rds(here("output", "01_extract_pairs", "combosDF.rds"))

doc_count_df <- combosDF_old |>
    group_by(docID) |>
    count()
doc_counts <- doc_count_df$n
names(doc_counts) <- doc_count_df$docID

combosDF <- combosDF |>
    left_join(doc_count_df, by = "docID") |>
    rename(doc_length = n)

rm(combosDF_old)
```
